newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins rise on derivatives issue news.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins rise on derivatives issue news.

text.p: Russian MinFins rose strongly on Friday amid rumours of an impending derivatives issue based on tranche four bonds and as subdued U.S. inflation data outweighed strong GDP growth, dealers said.

"Buying started on Thursday evening from London after banks learnt that JP Morgan is preparing to issue derivatives for the fourth MinFin tranche," a Moscow Narodny Bank dealer in London said. "That was the first push."
He said the fourth and third tranches were in most demand.
Last November, SBC Warburg issued 100 million marks of bonds secured against tranche three MinFins.
U.S. GDP rose an annualised 4.7 percent in the fourth quarter, but the price deflator was only 1.4 percent.
"At first, the reaction was mixed," the dealer said. "But later, the papers rose."
An Avtobank dealer said that in Russia, the fourth tranche rose most significantly on a single big order and other tranches followed.
